title: Deliverable
description: TOGAF-sourced archetype — a contractual output of a Work Package, representing a formally agreed-upon result of ADM work. Deliverables are composed of Artifacts (catalogs, matrices, diagrams). Placed in unclassified/ for GSM placement deliberation: may be a directive (prescriptive outcome), an interaction artifact (contractual exchange), or a structure (a system deliverable). TOGAF mapping: Deliverable (ADM Content Metamodel, Architecture Governance). Source framework: TOGAF (ADM, Content Framework).

deliverableType.description: Deliverable classification per TOGAF ADM output types. TOGAF mapping: ADM deliverable taxonomy.

admPhase.description: ADM phase that produces this deliverable. TOGAF mapping: ADM phase.

approvalStatus.description: Formal approval status of the deliverable. TOGAF mapping: Architecture Governance approval lifecycle.
